uuid.description: Unique key for the employee group

employeeGroupId.description: Ivo Systems database ID for the employee group

companyId.description: Ivo Systems company ID this group belongs to

employeeGroupName.description: Display name for the employee group

employeeGroupColor.description: Hex color code for the employee group

createdByUserId.description: User ID that created this group

createdTimestampUtc.description: UTC timestamp when the group was created

isActive.description: Whether the group is currently active

isDeleted.description: Whether the group has been soft deleted

canAccessEquipment.description: Permission flag: group members can access equipment

canAccessOtherEmployees.description: Permission flag: group members can access other employees

canAccessDailyJobNotes.description: Permission flag: group members can access daily job notes

canAccessOtherEmployeeDetails.description: Permission flag: group members can access other employee details

canAccessJobInformation.description: Permission flag: group members can access job information
